description:
FOLDED INTO fz-f98.21. Closed as a fold, not as a fix.

This ticket's own conclusion nominated that destination: "needs a canonical
rendering, which is fz-f98.21's subject. This ticket should either fold into it
or be limited to 'make --dump backend emit in a deterministic order', which is
the same work at a smaller scope." f98.21 now carries `--dump backend`
byte-stability as an explicit check.

## What was true and stays true

The fixpoint half is fixed and must not be reopened as a fixpoint bug. Settled
fact content does not wobble: `--dump activations` hashes identically across
runs, the `Kernel.dbg/1([int]|[])` widening flip is gone, and `enum_tier0`'s
answer conflation does not reproduce. Re-measured on
00420_enum_take_drop_split: program output and the entire public work SEQUENCE
(17,574 events) are byte-identical across three runs.

## What this ticket got wrong

It diagnosed the surviving `--dump backend` instability as "pure ORDER --
identical as a multiset of lines... `HashMap` iteration order in the rendering".
That was measured on `map_enumerable` and does not generalize.

On 00420_enum_take_drop_split the SORTED dumps also differ:

    md5 of sort(dump) x3 -> 4a153a56..., dca72f12..., 76a5f8f1...
    16 differing lines, identical 309,892 line count, identical byte length

The differing lines are `Ty(n)` ids. (The dump is `{:#?}`-pretty-printed, so ids
sit on their own line and `grep 'Ty([0-9]*)'` finds nothing -- a trap worth
knowing.) So there is a SECOND mechanism: run-to-run arena renumbering, not only
rendering order.

Root-caused into four clusters -- three are upstream mint-order dependence
(fz-kdt.47, which now carries the repro) and one is an interner canonicalization
gap (fz-kdt.48).

## Where the work went

- fz-f98.21 -- the canonical external form, and `--dump backend` byte-stability.
- fz-kdt.47 -- the mint-order clusters.
- fz-kdt.48 -- the canonicalization gap.

File fresh rather than reopening this.
title: Folded into fz-f98.21: backend dump instability is renumbering as well as render order
